mentions.name: Call Santa Tonight
mentions.description: This app lets parents schedule a 5-minute or 10-minute AI video call with Santa for their child. Santa speaks with the kid in a very realistic way, supports dialogue, asks questions, and can even tell if there is a gift for the kid. It is powered by a HeyGen AI avatar with no video recording involved.
mentions.audience: Parents scheduling a Santa video call for their child
mentions.source_excerpt: I created a simple app that lets your kid call Santa AI via video call. Parents can use this webpage to schedule a 5-minute or 10-minute call with Santa, who will speak to their child.
